GRID & LADDER WIDGETS                                       
─────────────────────                                       
                                                            
▌ Rule 1  Clean first Never compile without nuking the whole
▌ _build/prod tree.                                         
                                                            
▌ Rule 2  A note with no lead run-in still renders its label
▌ chip and body.                                            
                                                            
▌ No label And a note with no label leads straight into its 
▌ bold run-in.                                              
                                                            
                                                            
                                                            
INGEST                                                      
Decode document                                             
Parse the portable-doc envelope into a block tree.          
files: decode.go                                            
source: cli                                                 
↓                                                           
RENDER                                                      
Stack the widgets                                           
Each grid block collapses to a vertical stack.              
↓                                                           
EMIT                                                        
Write to the terminal                                       
Flush the composed lines to stdout.                         
source: tui                                                 
                                                            
╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮  
│ Info card                                              │  
│ An informational card carries the neutral-info tone    │  
│ border.                                                │  
╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯  
                                                            
╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮  
│ OK card                                                │  
│ A success card is tinted with the ok/success tone.     │  
╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯  
                                                            
╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮  
│ Warn card                                              │  
│ A warning card draws attention with the warn tone      │  
│ border.                                                │  
╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯  
                                                            
╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮  
│ Danger card                                            │  
│ A danger card signals a destructive or failing state.  │  
╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯  
                                                            
○  open  — backlog — not ready yet                          
○  ready  — unchecked — claim it now                        
⠋  in progress  — being worked right now                    
!  blocked  — something is required first                   
✓  done  — complete                                         
✕  cancelled  — abandoned or superseded                     
◌  considering  — a candidate being weighed                 
◎  researching  — under active investigation
